decision: Only explicit user interaction extends idle sessions; background polling does not.
authorization: Product owner explicitly approved actual user actions only on 2026-10-07.
constraints: Keep the existing 30 minute idle and 24 hour absolute limits. The earlier question incorrectly said seven days; correction given before implementation.
Use an authenticated CSRF-protected activity endpoint. Trusted visible-tab pointer, keyboard and wheel events are coalesced over at most15seconds without periodic heartbeats.
Expired sessions cannot be renewed. Authentication-required responses clear browser session data and unsaved sensitive forms.
